_comment: This file lists the kinds of file a project of this core can hold. Chimera's New Project window is built from it. Each kind is called a slot. A project file records its files under the slot ids used here.

slots.title: Game
slots.help: The Uzebox game: a .uze file (the program with a header that names it), or a .hex program as the Uzebox's compiler writes it.

slots.title: EEPROM
slots.help: The console's EEPROM (2 KB, where games keep high scores and saved games) at the start, for a project that begins from saved data: a file as Emulator > Export Save Data... writes it (eeprom.bin), or uzem's own eeprom.bin. Every game shares the one EEPROM, each in a block of its own. The file is never changed. Leave this empty to start with a blank EEPROM.
slots.nameHelp: an EEPROM file is identified by its extension, .bin.
